core.title: Standard Aluminum Cabinet Pull Omnia AL407
tags: omnia al407 aluminum cabinet door pulls

text.description_html:
Omnia AL407 Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

Just because this pull is simple in design, doesn't mean that it is boring. Sometimes classic design offers the most elegant style--granting a timelessness to any home with ease. Made of aluminum, this cabinet pull emulates the quality that Omnia products are known for. This pull is offered in 3 sizes, making it easy to find just fit.

Omnia's line of sophisticated Aluminum cabinet hardware have been painstakingly crafted by artisans who understand that a beautiful design must be as comfortable to the hand as it is pleasing to the eyes.

Available in 3 Sizes:

  • OMN-AL407/127 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 5", Overall Length: 5-7/16", Projection: 1-9/16"
  • OMN-AL407/159 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 6-1/4", Overall Length: 6-11/16", Projection: 1-9/16"
  • OMN-AL407/318 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 12-1/2", Overall Length: 12-15/16", Projection: 1-9/16"
